scope: main-thread running CPU per cycle, including between-tick control and pump CPU; off-main separately
clock_read_charge: 2*(1+warm_calls) reads per cycle times maximum measured unsubtracted CPU batch mean plus reported resolution quantum
other_charge: Subtract the full positive mean main-CPU delta times the upper query-bracketed B window from the warming numerator, even if this overlaps the clock-read charge
verdict_number: ratio of corrected warm CPU sum to full cycle CPU sum over the same cycles
failure: strictly above0.05, and mainCPU/rawP50/rawP99 mean deltas all inside maximum within-arm ranges; otherwise unproven
retention: All attempts remain. No replacement for an observed failure. Release between every cell. No wall-clock or limiter subtraction.
